rotuloPrioridade hides urgency of unanswered critical tickets (lib.php:56-57) — F20, product question, confidence 35, left unchanged
Inconsistent mysqli error handling (dead connect_errno/false checks under PHP 8.1+ exceptions) — F22 (index.php:9-12, lib.php:133-135)
notes: achados.json leb binding matches (LEB-100-A 1.1, sha 68088ab...). JSON and prose are consistent: 22 findings F1-F22 with the same locations and confidences. Mapping: F1->SEC-001, F5->SEC-003, F17->SEC-008, F9->SEC-013, F8->SEC-014, F6->SEC-015, F3->SEC-017, F13->BUG-001, F10->BUG-004, F12->PERF-001, F21->ARCH-002, F19->CLN-007; ARCH-009 not reported. SEC-008 and SEC-014 were identified and explained but deliberately left unfixed (D1, D3), so C3/C5 none. SEC-001 does not escape LIKE wildcards (D10 says % and _ intentionally stay wildcards); per rule 7 that would be an incomplete fix, but C3 comes from the probe, which passed. BUG-004: F10's main thrust is the shared-file race, but it explicitly states the leaked handle on query failure at lib.php:125-135, so C1/C2 full. ARCH-002 R3 none: only the visibility predicate was extracted; the model itself declined layer/template separation. COMP review: 7 public signatures and return shapes unchanged (listarChamados recasts prepared-statement ints back to strings; key order kept); status labels, routes, CSV header/order/labels, HTML table unchanged; schema/seed untouched; still mysqli. exportarCsv() without a session still emits all rows; the web route filters per session (rule 6: enforcement). mediaResposta stays global and returns the same float. Deployment caveat: DB_PASS/SMTP_API_KEY now required from the environment (empty fallback). No false positives; D6 correctly states the int-typed concatenations in tecnicoNome/verChamado are not injectable, and D10 correctly says an index would not help LIKE '%term%' (not the PERF-006 decoy).

expl_justification.clareza: It has a Resumo that leads with the attack chain (SQLi to MD5 to a technician account), a 'Como verifiquei' summary, uniform Onde/Mecanismo/Impacto-severidade/Confianca/O que fiz blocks for 22 findings, and numbered Decisoes D1-D11 cross-referenced from the findings. The prose is short and direct.
expl_justification.precisao: The claims are correct and deep. The CONCAT UNION puts login:md5 in the Titulo column. mysqlnd prepared statements return INT as int, so values are converted back to strings ('o teste de serialize confirma'). AVG returns a 4-place DECIMAL (25.6667) against PHP's 25.666666666666668. An explicit '\\' escape silences the 8.4 deprecation with identical bytes. In CHAR(32) a bcrypt UPDATE fails in strict mode and silently truncates otherwise, 'tranca o usuario para sempre'. D6 correctly says verChamado and tecnicoNome are not injectable because of the int/?int types. One nit: F11 places the deprecation output both 'no meio do CSV' and 'antes do cabecalho', and only the latter is right (the same nit as D).
expl_justification.causa_raiz: Every finding gives a concrete, mostly reproduced path: an anonymous GET of /tmp/chamados.csv served with the docroot layout, a planted PHPSESSID accepted under use_strict_mode off, and the shared file that would hand a client the technician's full CSV once F4 filters. F21 names the structural cause: per-field escaping is how '$busca ficou sem escape (F5)' and the missing single authorization point is how 'as tres rotas ignoraram a regra de visibilidade (F2-F4)'.
expl_justification.priorizacao: Critica items come first (SQLi and the visibility breaches), and dependencies are stated (F10 was 'pre-requisito para fazer F4 com seguranca'). The deploy prerequisites carry the operational risk. The tail is out of order without explanation: F11 (baixa) precedes F12-F13 (media), and F16-F18 and F21 (media) follow baixa items, the same pattern as D and K.
expl_justification.trade_offs: It compares alternatives throughout. Filtering the client export is chosen over blocking it ('bloquear esconderia do cliente chamados que ele tem direito de ver'). Filtering in PHP is weighed against changing the signature or duplicating the query (D7). AVG is weighed against PHP division, formula prefixing against billing consumers (with a separate spreadsheet export proposed), new labels against the management report's counts, SameSite Lax against external links, FULLTEXT against search semantics, and the dropped EXPORT_DIR file against undocumented readers (D8). MD5 is deferred with a concrete migration plan and a real unknown, other scripts that may write usuarios.senha, though the schema-gated rehash other reports shipped would have made safe progress meanwhile.
